payload.title: Open structured Markus wiki/help through a conventional Help entry
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a application user, I want an ordinary Help entry leading to structured documentation, so that I can browse and find product guidance without knowing its storage layout.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Open structured Markus wiki/help through a conventional Help entry
  Scenario: Enter Help and browse documentation
    Given an application configured with its documentation publication or knowledge base
    When I open its conventional Help entry
    Then I reach the appropriate structured Markus wiki/help with navigable topics and stable document links
    And headings, code examples, related links and available page metadata render consistently
    And deep links and narrow-screen or keyboard navigation remain usable
  Scenario: Chat is disabled
    Given optional chat is not configured
    When I open Help
    Then the complete wiki/help browsing experience is still available
```

Conventional label is Help; exact route, navigation tree, search choice and version selector require design. Preserve source provenance and applicable lifecycle/supersession behavior from PPY-964472; do not create a second evidence/publishing engine.
